You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"Hello South Slope Management,

The 2025 sink-cabinet work did not address an active plumbing leak caused inside our apartment. The inspection found condensation on an uninsulated cold-water riser; the supply, drain, trap, wall, and electrical components showed no leak.

The building repair was completed by insulating the riser, drying the cavity, and installing a removable moisture-resistant back panel. Final moisture readings were 8–9% against an 8% control; supply, drain, trap, and filled-basin tests were dry, the musty odor was gone, and the cabinet was returned to normal storage use. Management previously confirmed that this was a building repair with a $0 household charge. Devika and I owe $0 for it.

The December 14 portal showed a $0.00 rent balance and no late fee. Please remove the unsupported $680 tenant charge, correct the ledger, and send us the corrected ledger and written confirmation of the household balance. Please also confirm that no late fee or other balance will result from this disputed charge.

Thank you,
Alex"

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Find the newest South Slope management email about the $680 sink-cabinet charge and reply with the established cause, repair result, and household balance, asking for a corrected ledger in writing.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "send_email", "arguments": {"to": "billing@southslopemanagement.com", "subject": "Re: $680 tenant repair charge for 2025 sink-cabinet work", "body": "Hello South Slope Management,

The 2025 sink-cabinet work did not address an active plumbing leak caused inside our apartment. The inspection found condensation on an uninsulated cold-water riser; the supply, drain, trap, wall, and electrical components showed no leak.

The building repair was completed by insulating the riser, drying the cavity, and installing a removable moisture-resistant back panel. Final moisture readings were 8–9% against an 8% control; supply, drain, trap, and filled-basin tests were dry, the musty odor was gone, and the cabinet was returned to normal storage use. Management previously confirmed that this was a building repair with a $0 household charge. Devika and I owe $0 for it.

The December 14 portal showed a $0.00 rent balance and no late fee. Please remove the unsupported $680 tenant charge, correct the ledger, and send us the corrected ledger and written confirmation of the household balance. Please also confirm that no late fee or other balance will result from this disputed charge.

Thank you,
Alex", "cc": null}, "field_being_checked": "result.body"}

CRITERION:
The email disputes the $680 charge and says the cause was condensation on an uninsulated cold-water riser, with no supply, drain, trap, wall, or electrical leak. It says the riser was insulated, post-repair plumbing tests were dry, the odor was gone, and Alex and Devika owe $0. It asks management to remove the charge and confirm the corrected ledger in writing.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":true,"reason":"The email disputes the unsupported $680 charge; identifies condensation on an uninsulated cold-water riser and states there was no supply, drain, trap, wall, or electrical leak; says the riser was insulated, post-repair tests were dry, and the odor was gone; states “Devika and I owe $0”; and asks management to remove the charge, correct the ledger, and send written confirmation."}
